definitions.gloss: received email; incoming mail; inbox message
definitions.explanation: An email that has been received, as opposed to sent mail. Also refers to the inbox or received mail folder in an email application or on a mobile phone.

examples.japanese: {受信|じゅしん}メールを{確認|かくにん}する。
{受信|じゅしん}メールが{100件|ひゃっけん}たまっている。
examples.english: I have 100 unread emails piled up.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}な{受信|じゅしん}メールが{迷惑|めいわく}メールフォルダに{入|はい}っていないか{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check whether any important received emails have ended up in the spam folder.

notes:
A compound of {受信|じゅしん} (reception, receiving) and メール (email, mail). On Japanese mobile phones, the mail app historically had distinct {受信|じゅしん}ボックス (inbox) and {送信|そうしん}ボックス (sent box) labels. The term remains common even with modern email apps.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受信|じゅしん}メールを{開|ひら}く: to open a received email
- {受信|じゅしん}メール{一覧|いちらん}: list of received emails
- {受信|じゅしん}メールフォルダ: inbox folder
- {受信|じゅしん}メールを{削除|さくじょ}する: to delete received emails

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {送信|そうしん}メール: sent email — email that has been sent out
- {受信|じゅしん}ボックス: inbox — the folder/container for received messages
- {迷惑|めいわく}メール: spam email — unwanted messages filtered out by the email system
